# Kevin Tomorrow Field Work Command Pack

Purpose: turn scattered next-day work into one executable field plan.

## Kevin procedure
1. Capture every known job, delivery, pickup and site obligation for tomorrow.
2. Resolve the truck, trailer, equipment, tools, materials, documents, contacts and timing needed for each mission.
3. Put stops in a workable order and surface conflicts instead of hiding them.
4. Run the Morning Gate. Any NO is a blocker requiring resolution, owner clarification or a clearly stated contingency.
5. Produce a short owner brief: first mission, departure target, critical loadout, known risks and first unresolved decision.

Do not invent missing addresses, contacts, equipment assignments or deadlines. Mark unknowns explicitly. Purchases, external sends, credential use and owner-representing commitments remain outside this GREEN skill.
